payload.summary: GRILL SESSION COMPLETE (Jim live, chat 2026-08-01) — full decision set for the roadmap layer. STRUCTURE: three-generation tree mirroring a mind map — product nodes (light intent, pointer to persistent product design doc, ADR cross-refs) -> feature nodes (essentially the PRD; grill produces PRD -> epic -> items via existing CCPM pipeline) -> work items (unchanged). One record type 'roadmap node' with kind=product|feature|initiative, tree by parent, per-kind rules soft (LLM infers; validate warns at most). Initiatives = kind flag linking sideways into features, deeper rollup semantics deferred until a real one lands. STATUS: all derived, nothing hand-set — product from feature children (planned/in-flight/built), feature dev from epic rollup, QA from qa.sweep-completed, deploy/release from TWO NEW EVENT TYPES deploy.completed + release.announced. STORAGE: fully in-store — NO GitHub Issues this round (Jim explicitly re-scoped; he works agent-only, cross-agent sharing is the git-committed store itself); GH/linear/trello/jira become one-way VIEW mirrors later via c31rnb9k. Wayfinder method adopted, hosted on nahel state: maps + decision tickets (research/prototype/grilling/task) as lightweight in-store records, tickets distilled after map completion (decisions permanent in journal, bodies ephemeral). PRD LIFECYCLE: live until released, then ARCHIVED to docs/prds/archived/ with a stamped header (released date, epic link, 'code and tests are truth now') + journal pointer; never deleted; product design docs permanent and updated. ORDERING: horizon now|next|later only, no ranks; multiple parallel nows is the intended shape (agentic dev makes concurrency cheap — stated design principle). GOVERNANCE: trust+visibility, not enforcement — agents scribe freely, brief carries 'roadmap changes since your last touch'; governance.product config human|agent enables agent-as-PO swarm mode (Jim: full POC products built AFK). ANTI-WATERFALL PRINCIPLE: blocking is ADVISORY everywhere — maps need not complete before build; agents may deliberately start blocked items (journaled 'started with open blocker'); frontier = open+unblocked+unclaimed = the anti-waterfall device. CLI: nahel roadmap [ref] zooms the tree (slug on every node), brief gets capped roadmap block, nahel standup --since (curated journal view, zero new state), roadmap frontier in slice 2. SCOPE: three slices, one phase — S1 orientation (records, verbs, brief, standup, migrate the 8 headline items in both repos), S2 mapping (maps, tickets, frontier, two grill workflow docs), S3 lifecycle tail (deploy/release events, stage view, PRD archival). Out of scope: mindmap viz (64p2tza6), PM-tool adapters (c31rnb9k), multi-product stores (one product per store assumed). NEXT: author docs/prds/phase-4-roadmap-layer.md from this decision set, codex review, park for Jim's approval.
